# Antigravity CLI 1.2.2 Identity Fixture

Frozen identity and release-note classification for official GitHub
`google-antigravity/antigravity-cli` `1.1.27`, `1.1.28`, `1.2.0`, `1.2.1`,
and `1.2.2` (Research 323, g05.075).

- `identity.json` — release/tag/asset identity for the five new stable
  points (linux-x64 and mac-arm64 tarball digests, extracted binary
  digests/sizes/build ids), the reproduced `1.1.26` boundary, the
  observation-only host `agy 1.1.19`, and the per-claim
  catalogue-advance / headless-stop decision.
- `protocol.json` — selected-surface truth and the official
  release-note classification per claim under Tom's 2026-09-15 ruling
  that the official release notes are the behavioural authority for
  g05.075. Collected binary hashes from the pre-ruling probe are
  retained; exhaustive binary scanning stopped at the ruling.

No downloaded binary was executed. No provider, prompt, login,
credential, installation, or host-mutation operation occurred. The
decoder corpus remains `antigravity-cli-1.1.9`.
